segments.text: Ok so, this is the MCP apps page in the CopilotKit docs, for Deep Agents, the Python agent with React, and I have implemented this page in my project.
This is my project, the exact code from the doc.
So I asked it to draw a flowchart in Excalidraw, and uh, the agent just replied in text, no Excalidraw app showed up in the chat.
Back on the doc, this is the Excalidraw server URL from the page.
So that URL redirects to slash MCP, and the runtime log says MCP tool discovery failed, unexpected redirect.
So the agent never gets the Excalidraw tools. With the slash MCP URL, the drawing renders fine.
So yeah, this page needs a fix, kindly have a look.
